title: Elide one owned P104 carrier and save eight scalar units (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Remove one quarter-scaled owned carrier from the exact PR6621 native word. The new construction is produced by Nick Petalas. Claim type: scoped scalar-program construction with exact finite equivalence.

```diff
- initialize 774; copy 785; scale 774 by 1/4
- read 774 twice; erase 774
+ read the already live 785 with coefficient 1/4 twice
```

Four scalar events and one owned lifetime disappear. The complete declared scalar allowance falls from 137,866 to 137,858, saving eight units. The native-call sequence, productive boundary, paid/target moments and peak owned storage are identical. No new kappa, global scalar optimum or physical runtime speedup is claimed.

Source: DreamingOfClouds / PR6621 at `c51a142bb94c6d46ebee9a48c3f71cde8022da91`. Credit Ali Romman / PR6529, PR6545 and PR6551; Rohan Arun / PR6399 and PR6417; Erwan L. / PR6453; and the retained native/helper/compiler lineage. Copy elision and constant propagation are classical. The exact source word and its original attribution notice are retained unchanged.

The [proof](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b131b9f4e58c2cce59a41aa24f5311c37b053469/research/owned-carrier-copy-elision/PROOF.md) gives the six source events, arbitrary-input induction and full scalar delta. The [canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19375269) records the carrier-sharing attempt. The delivered first improvement is copy elision, rather than a paid-job reduction; no further construction search was performed after it passed.

## Evidence

- Before: 18,561 events, 46 owned lifetimes, scalar allowance 137,866. After: 18,557 events, 45 lifetimes, allowance 137,858. Peak owned storage remains 13.
- Exact rational comparison checks every one of the 638,401 coefficient positions of the complete old/new scalar maps. A separately written dense modular interpreter corroborates all 799 input columns. Neither interpreter asserts the predecessor's claimed endpoint.
- Both new reads have the existing frame 394. The ordered native job list and all boundary metadata agree exactly. Six wrong-scale, wrong-frame and missing-read controls reject.
- CPython 3.12.15 local normal and optimized direct checks passed in 1.951 s and 1.918 s; the registered replay of both passed in 4.059 s. Each registered check has a 120-second cap. Original-archive Git blob, SHA256, nested members and exact retained-byte equality passed locally without executing predecessor code.
- Metadata/pins, source syntax/function bounds, clean diff and committed bytes/history pass for all ten files at `b131b9f4e58c2cce59a41aa24f5311c37b053469`.

From the repository root, using the actual local interpreter:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/owned-carrier-copy-elision
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -B -W error research/owned-carrier-copy-elision/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -B -W error research/owned-carrier-copy-elision/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/owned-carrier-copy-elision --check-source-history
```

An installed CPython 3.12 path may be substituted elsewhere. The direct marker is `PASS_OWNED_CARRIER_COPY_ELISION`; receipts are generated and bound to every package file's SHA256. The README documents optional original-archive authentication. No unmerged Git object or network access is needed for ordinary replay.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This lowers the source's scalar tariff only. No complete physical bill, recursive root, supplier admission, selected cold replay, Lean build or complete multiplier was run. Native all-column behavior, owned erasure, compiler closure, precision/tape and analytic recovery remain inherited. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

This does not resolve the separate source-invoice objection raised in PR6638 or certify PR6621's kappa. The comparison proves only that this new word has the same scalar map, native sequence and boundary as the exact retained input. Local replay authenticates retained bytes; external publication provenance is a separately run optional archive comparison.

## Open next questions

Can a future paid transport be shared while preserving every intermediate reader and the public boundary? First name an overlapping carrier pair and a common future transport, then supply its complete causal consumer and restoration bill. No such construction is supplied or reserved here; the recursive signed moment is unchanged.

## Related open work

- PR6621 supplies the exact native word and its existing paid merges. This adds one copy-elision construction and does not review its scientific claim.
- PR6638 studies PR6621's invoice gate and retained receipt. That objection remains separate; no complete caller number is compared here.
- PR6529 supplies the underlying scaled-transport word. The present edit is in PR6621's assembled prefix and introduces no native map.
- PR6537 replaces a different output-correction block of PR6529 with 74 ADDs. No composition with that result or shared total is claimed.
- PR6485 composes scalar rewrites on the selected P104 word, with a different native chronology. This result is bound to PR6621; no combined scalar allowance is computed.
- PR6551 supplies the rebalanced retirement caller used by PR6621. That caller and its complete invoice are not changed or replayed.

Completion refresh checked all 16 open account PRs created since the CLAIM. No additional PR studying this owned-carrier rewrite or its scalar allowance was found, and no shared numerical result required comparison.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks passed at exact head `b131b9f4e58c2cce59a41aa24f5311c37b053469` in [run 41652430920](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41652430920): [plan](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41652430920/job/125973818041) in 4m36s and [registered package replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41652430920/job/125976492730) in 1m32s. Completed checks were read once with `gh pr checks 6647 --repo CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds`; separate run metadata confirms the same head and successful conclusion.

The hosted replay runs both registered normal and optimized checks. Local direct/registered checks, source-archive equality, metadata and committed-byte/source-history checks also passed. CI certifies execution of these declared checks, not supplier admission or independent mathematical acceptance. All five inherited framework assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** package.

Only `research/owned-carrier-copy-elision/` is added. Shared code, frozen predecessors and the selected frontier are preserved.
